summary_note: Compact summaries of installed-bundle reports. Retains checks, counted steps, clean bundle provenance, report hashes and cleanup. Verbose fixture payloads and temporary paths omitted. No total setup-time measurement is claimed.
scope: Fresh Linux users on one host, with independent homes, projects and real systemd user services. Local coordinator; fixture Claude executable with real adapter handshake and readiness. No live model, external release download, macOS or separate-machine validation.
recovery_coverage: Prerequisites and malformed launch options fail before network enrollment or agent registration
New/stopped services and existing units preserve the installed implementation and state
Stable network, person, agent and profile identities on rerun
Trust/untrust opt-ins, default calls off, and profile choice conflicts
Missing original person key is not replaced
Consumed invites resume an existing membership; invalid signatures are refused
Partial same-person binding stops before attachment and remains incomplete on retry
Real terminal hidden invite entry and cancellation restore echo without exposing the invite
Several network memberships are refused without changing the attachment
Coordinator outage stops a rerun; recovery retains identities (Rust CLI/Rust daemon)
